source: Black Clover wiki (en), Liebe: Appearance. Messy white hair, short, body coated in black with a line up the chest, two lines across the red eyes, two bat-like wings, two bull-like horns, long thin tail with a trident tip, pointed teeth, clawed fingers and toes

Black Clover wiki (en), Lucifero: Appearance. Tall, four bat-like wings, four curved upward horns (temples and sides), long light hair, pointed teeth and ears, dark sclera red irises slit pupils, thin bony hands with dark nails, long dark skirt, wrinkled twisted skin

Black Clover wiki (en), Beelzebub: Appearance. Large black figure, pointy ears, two wings, four horns (two small upright, two larger curving out and up), hair to the neck splitting into strands, fur on chest and shoulders

NOT on the English wiki (Astaroth has no Appearance section: only 'highest-ranking devil, Time Magic') and the Japanese wiki could not be fetched: this look is the mod's own design (golden, time-themed): cream hair, a clock ring behind the head, gold feathered wings, an hourglass gem

Black Clover wiki (en), Megicula: Appearance. Petite, pale from the neck up and black below, a black star pattern at the neck, three eyes with dark patches, big curved ram horns and thin upward forehead horns, long pointy ears, long wavy light hair turning to mist, light tentacles all over, bat wings covered in eyes, long thin tail with a heart tip

Black Clover wiki (en), Lucifugus: Appearance. Tall and slender, long pointed ears, two large ox-like horns, a pair of wings, a long prehensile tail; the palette (lavender, violet) follows the mod's Kotodama devil

Chainsaw Man wiki (en), Fox Devil: Appearance. An oversized arctic fox: a giant fox head covered in many giant eyes of concentric circles, a monstrously large arm with oversized claws covered in eyes; orange or light brown fur in the manga, white in the anime (the manga colouring is used), red-orange glowing eyes

Chainsaw Man wiki (en), Curse Devil: Appearance. A large two-headed skeleton with horns; the right skull is human-like, the left has three eye slits and longer mandible-like teeth; clawed hands and a large distended ribcage

Chainsaw Man wiki (en), Future Devil: Appearance. The lower half is a tree growing from the floor, a trunk and branches up to a humanoid body with outstretched arms and a horned head; vine-like streamers grow from the arms and chest; the face has three pairs of eyes stacked vertically and a wide, always open mouth; a large hole in the chest with an oversized eye inside

Chainsaw Man wiki (en), Ghost Devil: Appearance. A large devil with a cylindrical body covered in white flowers (pink outside, blue inside in the anime) with several arms instead of legs; grey skin; an old, desiccated head with long dark wavy hair and sunken cheeks; eyes and mouth sewn shut

Kuroshitsuji wiki (en), Sebastian Michaelis: Appearance. Tall, handsome adult, black hair, reddish-brown eyes (glowing fuchsia, slit pupils in the demon form), pale skin, black nails, tailcoat, vest, tie with the crest, white gloves, a chained pocket watch, high-heeled boots; demon form with claws, longer teeth, dark wings with many eyes

Blue Exorcist wiki (en), Iblis: Appearance (host and demon form). Dark skin, yellow eyes, a body that exudes flames, a third eye in the forehead early on; the demon form has a serpentine tail of molten rock, flame hair with the ponytail in bulbs, a belly dancer's clothes. The KIN is the mod's own design in that look

Blue Exorcist wiki (en), Egyn: Appearance (hosts). Light-blue hair darker toward the tips, a long teardrop-shaped horn at the top of the head, brown skin, gold octopus-like eyes, a small body (about half the height of Lucifer); the legs as tentacles of water are the mod's own design

Blue Exorcist wiki (en), Amaimon: Appearance (hosts). Green hair, a small pointed horn on top of the head, golden-green slit eyes with a red inner ring, long sharp nails; the hulking, rock-plated body of the KIN is the mod's own design

Blue Exorcist wiki (en), Astaroth: Appearance (hosts). Ram horns, longer sharper black nails, canine-like teeth, red bloodshot eyes, a demonic tail, a longer tongue, demonic mushrooms (one with four eyes) grown over the body; the KIN is the mod's own design in that look

Blue Exorcist wiki (en), Lucifer: Appearance (host). A tall, fair-skinned man with spiky slicked-back blond hair, a long blond tail, pointed ears, elongated canines, patches of diseased skin; the halo and white-gold coat are the mod's own design for the King of Light

Tensura wiki (en), Diablo (Primordial Noir): Appearance. Black hair with red and gold streaks, golden eyes with red pupils and black sclera, princely garments that became a butler outfit with a red chain; daemon horns and claws, wings he unfolds

Tensura wiki (en), Testarossa (Primordial Blanc): Appearance. An alluring woman with waist-long white hair and crimson eyes, a black military uniform with baggy trousers (tallest of the three Primordials Diablo recruited); daemon horns and wings

Tensura wiki (en), Carrera (Primordial Jaune): Appearance. A young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and blue eyes, a black snow coat with a skull pin over a white shirt and tie, the air of a delinquent; daemon horns and wings

Tensura wiki (en), Ultima (Primordial Violet): Appearance. A cute girl with middle-length purple hair in a side ponytail, purple nails, yellow eyes, a black skirted military uniform with an armband; twelve bat-like wings on her back

Tensura wiki (en), Guy Crimson (Primordial Rouge): Appearance. A handsome man with wavy waist-length rouge hair, blood-red eyes with gold and silver stars and two black stripes under each, a dark open jacket over a muscular chest with layered tooth and fang necklaces, a red sash and loose dark trousers; daemon horns, wings and claws

Tensura wiki (en), Misery (Primordial Vert): Appearance. A strikingly beautiful woman with long wavy green hair past the shoulders, green eyes, a deep-red maid dress and long elbow-length fingerless green gloves; daemon horns and wings

Tensura wiki (en), Rain (Primordial Bleu): Appearance. A cute young woman with medium-length blue hair and blue eyes, a deep-red maid dress and long elbow-length fingerless blue gloves; daemon horns and wings

Dororo wiki (en), 48 Demons / Hall of Hell / Twelfth Demon (Asura): the Hall of Hell is a temple of statues of the 48 demons; in the 2019 anime the Twelfth Demon's statue has three heads and six arms, resembling Brahma; its true form is a blob under the castle (not drawn). The figure is that statue come to life

Berserk wiki (en), God Hand and Femto/Griffith pages: the page fetched is the lead and infobox only (silver hair, blue eyes, 'Wings of Darkness'); the look is the Femto form from memory of the manga (a pale lord in white and gold, a horned crest, huge dark and white wings, a crimson cloak and the Beherit gem); the other four members are not drawn

Fairy Tail wiki (en), Etherious and Mard Geer: Appearance. Mard Geer is tall and lean with a young man's look, long wavy dark purple hair mostly tied in a very large ponytail, messy bangs hiding dark slanted eyes, a smirk; Etherious are demons made from Zeref's books with curse marks and a transformed Etherious Form (the horns and the marks are the mod's design; the form itself was not described on the pages fetched)
